createAccount.title: Create your account
createAccount.subtitle: Takes about two minutes. You can save and finish later.
createAccount.namePlaceholder: As you want us to greet you
createAccount.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence you will remember works well.
createAccount.termsLabel: I agree to the {terms} and have read the {privacy}.
createAccount.researchConsentLabel: Optional: use my anonymous answers to improve Migration Hub. You can change this any time.
createAccount.disclaimer1: Migration Hub is a planning tool. We are not a regulator, a law firm or an immigration adviser, and we never guarantee outcomes.
createAccount.disclaimer2: We will never ask for your password or any payment by message or email.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.bodyPre: If a new account can be created for
checkEmail.bodyPost: we have sent you a link. Open it to confirm your email. It signs you in and takes you to the next step.
checkEmail.linkNotice: The link works once and expires after a short time. Nothing is saved to your account until you open it.
checkEmail.cannotFindBody: Check your spam folder. Our emails come only from {domain}. We will never ask for your password or payment in an email.

aboutYou.title: Tell us about your work
aboutYou.subtitle: We use this to show only the routes that apply to you.
aboutYou.whyTrainedIn: Why we ask: requirements depend on where you qualified.

whereTo.title: Where are you thinking of going?
whereTo.subtitle: Pick up to three. The first one you tap is your top choice. You can change this later.
whereTo.waitlistLink: Tell us and join the waitlist
whereTo.waitlistPost: It helps us decide where to go next.
whereTo.disclaimer: Choosing a country does not guarantee a route. Always confirm with the official regulator.

waitlist.title: We are not live for that yet
waitlist.subtitle: We do not cover this combination today. Join the waitlist and we will email you when we do. What you tell us helps decide what we build next.
waitlist.freeTextLabel: Not the right profession? Tell us yours (optional)
waitlist.consentLabel: Email me when this becomes available. We use your answers only for this and to plan what to build.
waitlist.footer: Your account stays open. You get full access to plans as soon as your profession and countries launch.

signIn.title: Sign in to your account
signIn.subtitle: Continue planning your migration journey.
signIn.errorUnknown: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.confirmationBody: If an account exists for that email, we have sent instructions to reset your password.

newPassword.title: Set new password
newPassword.subtitle: Choose a strong password with at least 10 characters.
newPassword.successNotice: Your password has been reset successfully. You can now sign in.
